checks: Read each current acceptance and evidence reference in src/progress.json.

auditMethod.decisionMeaning: promote-to-released is an audit recommendation for the root to apply in progress.json; this file does not update task statuses.

No candidate is held for the independent PUBLICHTTPS1 condition.
